title: quercus faginea subvar. microphylla
intro: Quercus faginea subvar. microphylla, commonly known as the microphylla oak, is a variety of evergreen oak tree that belongs to the Quercus faginea species. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which have been used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and oxidative stress. The health benefits of Quercus faginea subvar. microphylla include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial agent, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as arthritis, diabetes, and certain types of infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
